name: keyed-lww-key-arity-refused
description: A caller-supplied rule table binds one keyed-lww target ('verdict') to two rules whose Key tuples disagree on length: op_version 1's ['subject','revision'] and op_version 2's ['subject'], the shorter a strict prefix of the longer -- the shape that previously reached the Result() comparator's pairwise key-component ordering and panicked with index out of range (WRIT-234, WRIT-239). Fold refuses the rule table outright (WRIT-239's ruling: refuse rather than silently order shorter-first, which would bless two prefix-related tuples as permanent distinct registers) rather than reducing partially. A sibling 'score' target using a well-formed lww rule shows the refusal is whole-fold, not per-target: even though 'score' alone is perfectly foldable, the fold as a whole returns an error.
